svg.text: One-sided layout: power bank and all boards in the right head, steel balance washers in the left head, pulse sensor in the top of the grip. Hex section as CAD v0.1 (100 across corners, 86.6 across flats); head depth 70 -> 110 to fit the power bank. Not a print file; sizes marked * are catalogue values, measure the parts.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lines: solid = visible edge; dashed = hidden edge; hatched = printed part cut by the section; dense hatch = steel; colour blocks = component envelopes (orange power bank, green PCB, blue display, red pulse sensor, purple wire).

svg.text: 1. Head depth 70 -> 110: bank 80 along the axis + grip insertion 10 + cable bend 14.5 + wall 2.5 + cap 3. Overall 280 -> 360. Section unchanged; the

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 80 mm width candidate is still open.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Buttons 3 -> 1, buzzer dropped. OLED window, button and LED all on the right head's top flat; no USB opening for the Nano in the cap, the bank's

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cable powers it, flashing means opening the cap.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. A half breadboard 83 x 55 x 10 fits no way into a 110 head (cavity 104.5, max inner width 94); a perfboard with female headers is the hub, Nano and

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Mass estimate (PLA 1.24 g/cm3, 2.5 walls): two heads about 300 g, grip about 95 g, ribs about 30 g; bank 115 g, boards about 60 g; 8 washers 350 g

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left head about 180 g heavier than the right. 4 washers balance the heads at about 0.8 kg total; 12 washers give 1.15 kg but 360 g off balance. No

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: room for washers in the right head: a trade-off to decide.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5. Pulse module in the top of the grip, slightly left of centre, chip flush, recess blocks light. Finger contact not yet verified (do not freeze

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: before the AT heart-rate test); may move to the side of the grip.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
